payload.description: bmad-method 6.10.0 quick-update path (reinstall over existing install) ignores CLI --pin flags entirely: channel decisions are rebuilt from the installed manifest, and stable-channel external modules float to the newest non-major tag. Observed live: --pin tea=v1.19.1 --pin bmad-loop=v0.9.0 passed, installer delivered tea v1.21.7 and bmad-loop v0.9.1; verify-at-pin caught the drift and failed the run. Reinstall-at-pin is only deterministic while pin == latest stable tag. Root: tools/installer/core/installer.js quick-update channelOptions rebuilt from manifest (channel: stable → classifyUpgrade floats patch/minor).
